limitations: Proposed task-local prototype only; it does not change the canonical generator, selected rule, or approval state.
Only halo_radius in {1,2} is supported; radius 1 is the exact canonical program.
Prototype multi-cell components stay at least two cells from every edge so both settings expose the complete added ring.
Singletons are sampled outside each radius-2 expanded box to keep the parameter contrast visually direct.
Evidence retains one four-pair episode per setting and tests all four query rotations against the other declared setting.
Finite two-setting evidence does not establish unique induction against arbitrary programs or production training suitability.
A labeled canary used for Racket bridge verification is private runtime plumbing, not a public episode.

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (visited (make-hash))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (when
                     (and (= (at g r c) 2) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
                     (let ((cells (list)))
                       (let bfs
                            ((q (list (list r c))))
                            (unless
                              (null? q)
                              (let ((cr (first (car q)))
                                    (cc (second (car q))))
                                (cond
                                  ((or
                                     (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                                     (< cr 0)
                                     (>= cr hh)
                                     (< cc 0)
                                     (>= cc ww)
                                     (!= (at g cr cc) 2)) (bfs (cdr q)))
                                  (else (hash-set! visited (list cr cc) #t)
                                        (set! cells (cons (list cr cc) cells))
                                        (bfs (append (cdr q)
                                                     (list (list (- cr 1) cc)
                                                           (list (+ cr 1) cc)
                                                           (list cr (- cc 1))
                                                           (list cr (+ cc 1))))))))))
                       (when
                         (>= (length cells) 2)
                         (let ((r1 (min-of first cells))
                               (c1 (min-of second cells))
                               (r2 (max-of first cells))
                               (c2 (max-of second cells)))
                           (for* ((br (range (- r1 1) (+ r2 2))) (bc (range (- c1 1) (+ c2 2))))
                                 (when
                                   (and
                                     (>= br 0)
                                     (< br hh)
                                     (>= bc 0)
                                     (< bc ww)
                                     (zero? (hash-ref result (list br bc) 0)))
                                   (hash-set! result (list br bc) 3))))))))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
